summary: Hepion Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing its October 6, 2026 acquisition of all outstanding membership interests in Gravitas Life Sciences, LLC from Gravitas Collective Corp. (the sole member). Consideration was $2.0 million cash plus 25,000,000 shares valued at $2,250,000 (a $2.25 million stock component at the Buyer Closing Stock Price), plus $135,000 additional cash. Stock issuance is capped at 19.99% of post-issuance outstanding shares, with excess settled in cash. Buyer Closing Shares are locked up six months and subject to forfeiture; piggyback registration rights granted. A Canton-related payoff letter and unsecured promissory note assignment were signed. Watch dilution, lock-up expiration, and resale registration timing as the arb angle.
